HELP   Keyboard shortcuts (press any key to return)

  Arrows              Move            Shift+arrows      Select
  Ctrl+arrows         Jump to the edge of the data (add Shift to select)
  Tab / Shift+Tab     Right / left    PgUp / PgDn       Screen up / down
  Home / Ctrl+Home    Column A / A1   Ctrl+End          Last used cell
  Mouse               Click, drag or Shift+click to select; click headers
                      for whole columns or rows; double-click to edit

  Shift+F10             Cell menu                  Ctrl+O                Open
  Del / Backspace       Clear                      Ctrl+V                Paste
  Ctrl+C                Copy                       Ctrl+Shift+V          Paste values only
  Ctrl+X                Cut                        Ctrl+Q                Quit
  Ctrl+Alt+-            Delete rows or columns     Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y Redo
  Esc                   Deselect                   Ctrl+S                Save
  F2 / Enter            Edit cell                  Ctrl+K / Ctrl+Shift+P / Alt+/Search the menus
  Ctrl+D                Fill down                  Ctrl+A                Select all
  Ctrl+R                Fill right                 Ctrl+Space            Select columns
  Ctrl+G / F5           Go to                      Shift+Space           Select rows
  Ctrl+Alt+=            Insert rows or columns     Ctrl+Z                Undo
  F10                   Menu

  Typing replaces the cell. Start with = for a formula, ' to force text.
  While typing a formula, arrows after an operator pick cells.

  Functions: ABS AND AVERAGE COUNT COUNTA FALSE IF IFERROR INT MAX MIN MOD NA NOT OR PI ROUND SQRT
             SUM TRUE
